230: Set your hips high in an inverted V with hands and feet on the floor, forming a pike shape. Lower the crown of your head toward the floor by bending the elbows, then press back up to the start.
231: Place your feet on a bench and hands on the floor, hips lifted high to steepen the pike angle. Lower the crown of your head toward the floor by bending the elbows, then press back up to the start.
232: Set your hands wider than shoulder-width with a straight line from head to heels. Shift your weight to one side, bending that elbow while the other arm stays straight, then push back to center and alternate.
233: Lower into a wide push-up until your chest is near the floor on one side. Shift your weight side to side while staying low, then press up to the start once you've moved across.
234: Set hands slightly wider than shoulders with a straight line from head to heels. Lower with control, then push explosively so your hands leave the floor, landing softly to absorb the impact.
235: Start in a downward-dog position with hips high, hands and feet on the floor. Dive the chest forward and down in an arc, sweeping up into an upward-facing position, then reverse the arc back to the start.
236: Hold a straight-arm plank position with hands under the shoulders. Let the shoulder blades sink together and down between the arms, then push the floor away to round the upper back, without bending the elbows.
237: Hold a high plank with hands under the shoulders and feet slightly wider than hip-width for stability. Tap one shoulder with the opposite hand while bracing the core to keep the hips still, then alternate sides.
238: Stand facing a wall with hands flat against it slightly wider than shoulder-width, arms extended. Lower your chest toward the wall by bending the elbows, then press back to the start.
239: Start in a plank with your feet against the base of a wall. Walk your feet up the wall while walking your hands in toward it, climbing as high as control allows, then reverse back down.
240: Kick up into a handstand against a wall for support, hands slightly wider than shoulders. Lower the head toward the floor by bending the elbows, then press back up to full arm extension.
241: Kick up into a freestanding or wall-supported handstand with hands slightly wider than shoulders. Lower the head toward the floor by bending the elbows, then press back up to full extension.
242: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair with hands gripping the edge beside your hips, legs extended. Lower your hips toward the floor by bending the elbows, then press back up to full extension.
243: Grip both sides of a doorway frame and lean back with feet planted and body straight. Pull your chest toward the frame by driving the elbows back, then lower slowly under control.
244: Loop a towel around a sturdy anchor point and lean back holding both ends with arms extended, feet planted. Pull your chest toward the anchor by driving the elbows back, then lower slowly under control.
245: Lie face down with arms extended overhead in a Y shape, thumbs up. Raise the arms off the floor by squeezing the lower traps and shoulder blades, then lower slowly under control.
246: Lie face down with arms extended out to the sides in a T shape, thumbs up. Raise the arms off the floor by squeezing the shoulder blades together, then lower slowly under control.
247: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs straight. Raise the arms, chest, and legs off the floor simultaneously by squeezing the lower back and glutes, then lower under control.
248: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs straight. Lift the arms, chest, and legs off the floor together and hold the position, breathing steadily without straining the neck.
249: Lie face down with arms at your sides, palms down, and chest slightly lifted. Sweep the arms up overhead in an arc like a snow angel, squeezing the shoulder blades, then reverse the arc back down.
250: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width, arms fully extended. Keep the shoulders relaxed away from the ears and hold the position for time, breathing steadily.
251: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and engage the shoulders by pulling the shoulder blades down and back. Hold the position with the lats active rather than passively hanging, breathing steadily for time.
252: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended and a shoulder-width grip. Pull the shoulder blades down and together without bending the elbows, then relax back to a dead hang.
253: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar, gripping it overhand at shoulder-width. Lower yourself as slowly as possible until the arms are fully extended, then reset and repeat.
254: Hang from the bar with hands gripping it one in front of the other, body facing sideways to the bar. Pull your head to one side of the bar, then alternate sides on each rep, lowering fully between.
255: Hang from the bar with legs extended straight out in front at hip height, forming an L shape. Pull your chest toward the bar while holding the leg position, then lower fully under control.
256: Drape towels over the bar and grip one in each hand instead of the bar itself. Pull your chest toward the bar by driving the elbows down, then lower fully under control, gripping hard throughout.
257: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front for balance. Sit down and back until the thighs are at least parallel to the floor, then drive through the feet to stand back up.
258: Stand on one leg with the other extended straight out in front, arms reaching forward for balance. Lower down on the standing leg until the hips near the heel, then drive through the foot to stand back up.
259: Stand on one leg holding a support like a rack or strap with the other leg extended in front. Lower down on the standing leg using the support for balance, then drive through the foot to stand back up.
260: Stand on one leg holding the other foot behind you with your hand, torso leaning slightly forward. Lower the back knee toward the floor while bending the standing leg, then drive through the foot to stand.
261: Take a wide stance with toes pointed slightly out, arms extended forward for balance. Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee to sit down while the other leg stays straight, then push back to center and switch sides.
262: Stand holding a support for balance, rising onto the balls of your feet with knees pushed forward. Lean the torso back as you lower toward the floor by bending the knees deeply, then drive back up through the quads.
263: Stand tall with hands on your hips and step forward into a lunge until both knees reach about 90 degrees. Drive through the front heel to push back to standing, then alternate legs.
264: Stand tall and take a wide step to one side, keeping the other leg straight. Push the hips back and bend the stepping knee to lower down, then drive through that heel to return to standing.
265: Stand tall and step one leg diagonally behind the other, crossing behind into a curtsy position. Lower until both knees bend to about 90 degrees, then drive through the front heel to return to standing.
266: Stand on one leg with the other leg bent behind you off the floor, arms reaching forward. Lower down on the standing leg by bending the knee and hip, tapping the back knee lightly if needed, then drive back up.
267: Stand on one leg in front of a box or bench, arms reaching forward for balance. Lower down by bending the standing leg until you sit lightly on the box, then drive through the foot to stand back up.
268: Stand on a box or step with one foot, letting the other leg hang off the edge. Lower the hanging foot toward the floor by bending the standing knee, tap lightly, then drive back up to standing.
269: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a wall or support for balance if needed. Rise onto the balls of the feet as high as possible, then lower the heels slowly for a full stretch.
270: Stand on one foot with the other leg lifted, holding a support for balance. Rise onto the ball of the foot as high as possible, then lower the heel slowly for a full stretch.
271: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, then drive the hips up into a bridge. Holding the bridge position, alternately lift one knee toward the chest at a time without letting the hips drop.
272: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped open wide. Drive the hips up by squeezing the glutes, keeping the feet together, then lower under control.
273: Start on all fours with hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips. Drive one heel toward the ceiling by extending the hip and squeezing the glute, then lower without arching the back.
274: Start on all fours with hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips. Lift one bent knee out to the side, keeping the hips level, then lower back down without rotating the torso.
275: Lie on your side with knees bent and stacked, hips stacked, and feet together. Rotate the top knee open like a clamshell by squeezing the glute, keeping the feet together, then lower slowly.
276: Stand on one leg with a slight forward hinge, arms out to the sides for balance. Rotate the hips and torso open and closed over the standing leg while keeping it stable, then reset and switch legs.
277: Lie on your side with legs stacked and straight, resting your head on your lower arm. Raise the top leg toward the ceiling by squeezing the glute, then lower slowly under control.
278: Lie on your side with legs stacked and straight, propping your head on your hand. Raise the top leg upward while keeping it straight and the hips stacked, then lower slowly under control.
279: Lie on your back with hips bridged up and heels close to the glutes, feet flat. Slowly walk the feet forward while keeping the hips lifted, then walk them back in without letting the hips drop.
280: Lie on your back with a towel under your heels on a smooth floor, hips bridged up. Slide the heels toward the glutes by contracting the hamstrings, then slide them back out under control.
281: Lie on your back with your heels resting on a stability ball, hips lifted into a bridge. Curl the ball toward your glutes by bending the knees, then extend the legs back out under control.
282: Loop a resistance band just above the knees and lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat. Push through the heels to raise the hips while pressing the knees out against the band, then lower slowly.
283: Loop a resistance band just above the knees and sit with your upper back against a bench, feet planted. Drive through the heels to raise the hips while pressing the knees out against the band, squeezing the glutes at the top.
284: Loop a resistance band just above the knees and lie on your back with the soles of the feet together, knees open. Drive the hips up by squeezing the glutes and pressing the knees out against the band, then lower slowly.
285: Loop a resistance band around the thighs and lie on your side with knees bent and feet together. Rotate the top knee open against the band by squeezing the glute, then lower slowly under control.
286: Loop a resistance band around the ankles or above the knees and stand in a slight quarter-squat. Step sideways against the band's resistance, maintaining tension, then bring the trailing foot in without fully closing the stance.
287: Loop a resistance band around the ankles and stand in a quarter-squat with knees pressed out. Step forward diagonally in a wide, deliberate stride, keeping tension on the band with every step.
288: Loop a resistance band just above the knees and stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down while pressing the knees out against the band, then drive through the feet to stand back up.
289: Loop a resistance band above the knees and start on all fours with hands under the shoulders. Drive one heel toward the ceiling against the band's resistance by squeezing the glute, then lower without arching the back.
290: Loop a resistance band above the knees and start on all fours with hands under the shoulders. Lift one bent knee out to the side against the band's resistance, keeping the hips level, then lower slowly.
291: Loop a resistance band around one foot and anchor the other end under the opposite foot or a post, hinge slightly forward. Kick the banded leg straight back by squeezing the glute, then return under control.
292: Loop a resistance band around the ankles and stand holding support with a slight hinge forward. Sweep one leg out to the side against the band's resistance by squeezing the glute, then return under control.
293: Loop a resistance band just above the knees and sit tall on a bench or chair with feet flat. Press the knees outward against the band by squeezing the glutes, then return slowly to the start.
294: Hold a resistance band with both hands in front of your chest, arms extended and shoulder-width apart. Pull the band apart by driving the arms out to the sides and squeezing the shoulder blades, then return slowly.
295: Anchor a resistance band at upper-chest height and grip it with palms facing in, arms extended. Pull the band toward your face, flaring the elbows high and squeezing the shoulder blades, then extend back slowly.
296: Anchor a resistance band at chest height and step back to create tension, holding the ends with arms extended. Pull the band toward the torso by driving the elbows back, then extend slowly under control.
297: Anchor a resistance band overhead and kneel or sit facing it, gripping the ends wider than shoulder-width. Pull the band down toward the chest by driving the elbows down and back, then let it rise under control.
298: Anchor a resistance band at chest height and stand side-on, holding the free end at your chest with both hands. Press the band straight out in front of you, resisting the pull rotating your torso, then bring it back.
299: Anchor a resistance band low or high and stand side-on, gripping it with both hands and a slight knee bend. Rotate the torso to pull the band across the body, then return under control resisting the twist back.
300: Loop a resistance band around your feet and lie on your back with arms reaching up and knees bent at 90 degrees. Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor against the band's tension, then return and switch sides.
301: Lie on your back and press the lower back into the floor, lifting the shoulders and legs a few inches up. Hold the dish shape with arms extended overhead or at your sides, breathing steadily without letting the back arch.
302: Set up in a hollow body position with lower back pressed down, shoulders and legs lifted, arms overhead. Rock gently back and forth from shoulders to hips while maintaining the hollow shape and steady breathing.
303: Lie flat on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight. Simultaneously raise the torso and legs to meet in a V shape, reaching the hands toward the toes, then lower back down under control.
304: Lie on your back with hands under your lower back or at your sides, legs extended and lifted a few inches. Alternate kicking the legs up and down in a small, steady rhythm while keeping the lower back pressed down.
305: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands at your sides or under your hips for support. Raise the legs straight up toward the ceiling by contracting the lower abs, then lower slowly without arching the back.
306: Lie on your back with legs extended straight up toward the ceiling and arms reaching upward. Curl the shoulders off the floor to reach toward your toes by contracting the abs, then lower slowly under control.
307: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, arms at your sides, and shoulders slightly lifted. Reach one hand down to tap the corresponding heel by crunching sideways, then alternate sides.
308: Hold a high plank with hands stacked under the shoulders and feet set wider than hip-width for a stable base. Reach one hand across to tap the opposite shoulder without letting the hips twist or sag, then alternate sides.
309: Hold a high plank with hands under the shoulders and feet together. Jump the feet out wide and back together in a jack motion while keeping the hips level and core braced throughout.
310: Start on all fours with hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips, then lift the knees an inch off the floor. Hold the position with a flat back and braced core, breathing steadily without raising the hips.
311: Start on all fours with hands under the shoulders and knees hovering just off the floor. Crawl forward by moving the opposite hand and foot together, keeping the hips low and back flat throughout.
312: Sit with hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your feet, and lift your hips into a tabletop position. Walk the hands and feet forward or backward while keeping the hips elevated and core braced.
313: Stand tall, then hinge forward to walk your hands out on the floor into a high plank. Walk the hands back toward your feet, keeping the legs as straight as comfortable, then stand back up.
314: Support your body on parallettes or the floor with arms straight, legs extended out in front at hip height. Hold the L shape with shoulders depressed away from the ears, breathing steadily without letting the legs drop.
315: Sit on the floor or edge of a bench, leaning back slightly with hands braced behind or beside you. Pull the knees toward the chest by contracting the abs, then extend the legs back out under control.
316: Prop yourself on one forearm in a side plank with feet stacked and hips lifted. Lower the hips toward the floor under control, then drive back up to the starting side plank height by squeezing the obliques.
317: Lie on your side with your top foot resting on a bench and the bottom leg free, propped on your forearm. Lift the bottom leg and hips off the floor by squeezing the inner thigh and obliques, holding for time.
318: Lie on a bench gripping it behind your head and press the shoulders down to lift the body into a straight line off the bench. Lower the body slowly as a rigid unit by contracting the abs, then raise back up before the hips touch.
319: Start standing, then drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor, kicking the feet back into a plank. Perform a push-up if able, jump the feet back to the hands, then explode upward into a jump.
320: Start standing, then drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor, kicking the feet back into a plank. Immediately jump the feet back to the hands and stand back up without a jump or push-up.
321: Start standing, then squat down and place your hands on the floor, kicking the feet back into a plank position. Immediately jump the feet back in toward the hands and return to standing.
322: Stand tall with a slight forward lean and drive one knee up toward the chest at a time. Alternate legs quickly while pumping the arms, landing on the balls of the feet with each step.
323: Start standing with feet together and arms at your sides. Jump the feet out wide while raising the arms overhead, then jump back to the start, repeating at a steady rhythm.
324: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and the other leg crossed behind. Push off and hop laterally to land on the opposite leg, absorbing the landing with a soft knee, then repeat side to side.
325: Start in a slight athletic squat with feet shoulder-width apart. Shuffle sideways with quick, low steps without crossing the feet, keeping the hips low and chest up throughout.
326: Stand tall in a slight athletic stance with knees soft and arms bent at your sides. Quickly alternate tapping the feet up and down in place, staying light on the balls of the feet.
327: Start standing, then drop your hands to the floor and kick both feet back explosively into a plank. Immediately jump the feet back in toward the hands and return to standing to repeat.
328: Start standing with feet together and arms extended straight out in front at chest height. Jump the feet out wide while swinging the arms out to the sides and back, then reverse to the start.
329: Start on all fours with hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips. Arch the back and lift the chest and tailbone for cow, then round the spine and tuck the chin for cat, flowing slowly between the two while breathing.
330: Stand tall with arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height. Make small, controlled circles with the arms, gradually increasing the size, then reverse direction halfway through.
331: Step into a deep lunge with the back leg straight and both hands on the floor inside the front foot. Rotate the torso and reach one arm toward the ceiling, then return the hand down and repeat on the other side.
332: Stand holding a wall or support for balance, standing on one leg. Swing the free leg forward and backward in a controlled arc through a comfortable range, then switch to swinging it side to side.
333: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms held loosely out in front or across the chest. Rotate the torso side to side in a controlled twist, letting the arms swing naturally with the motion.
334: Stand in a doorway with your forearm braced against the frame, elbow bent to about 90 degrees. Step forward through the doorway until you feel a stretch across the chest and front shoulder, and hold while breathing steadily.
335: Kneel on the floor with your big toes touching and knees spread wide, then sit back onto your heels. Reach the arms forward on the floor and lower the chest between the knees, holding the stretch and breathing steadily.
336: Kneel on one knee with the other foot planted in front, both knees at about 90 degrees. Shift your weight forward while keeping the torso upright until you feel a stretch in the front of the kneeling hip, and hold while breathing steadily.
337: Sit or stand with one leg extended straight, either propped on a low surface or on the floor in front. Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch behind the thigh, and hold while breathing steadily.
338: Stand tall, holding a wall or support for balance, and grab one ankle behind you. Pull the heel toward the glute while keeping the knees close together, and hold the stretch while breathing steadily.
339: Sit on the floor with legs extended straight out in front and feet flexed. Hinge forward from the hips, reaching toward the feet with a long spine, and hold the stretch while breathing steadily, easing deeper without bouncing.
340: Stand or sit tall and bring one arm straight across your chest at shoulder height. Use the opposite hand to gently pull the arm closer to the body, and hold the stretch while breathing steadily.
341: Stand facing a wall with hands braced against it and one foot back, heel pressed flat to the floor. Lean forward through the hips, keeping the back leg straight, until you feel a stretch in the calf, and hold while breathing steadily.
342: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out to the sides. Hold your feet and gently press the knees toward the floor with your elbows, holding the stretch and breathing steadily without bouncing.
